== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[A Wretched Hive (Virtual Block 8)|A Wretched Hive]], release 8.3 of [[Virtual Block 8]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of March 28, 2013". The file was created on 3 April 2013.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf VirtualBlock8_3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174721/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Internet Archive].
